title: Term coordinates of its block code
statement: Let $T$ be a DNF term of width at most $w$, let $S$ be a set of positions among its literals, and let $x$ be a binary assignment on $n$ coordinates. The list of term coordinates selected by the block code of $T$ formed from $S$ and $x$ is exactly the list of coordinates of the literals in $S$.
hypotheses_covered: The term width is at most $w$
